name: rsi_connors_pullback_v49
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms executing directional mandates over 15-30 minute windows create persistent micro-trends visible as price holding above the 15-minute SMA. Within these flows, every 60-120 seconds there is a brief momentum pause as one algo batch completes — visible as RSI(12) (1-minute RSI) dipping below 45 while the trend structure remains intact. At this exact point, passive limit orders from delta-hedging market makers (who are continuously re-hedging short-gamma positions) provide a structural bid that absorbs the temporary selling pressure, triggering resumption of the institutional flow. Entering ATM calls at RSI(12) < 45 while close remains above the 15-min SMA exploits this predictable 30-90 second re-acceleration in NIFTY's institutional order flow.

indicators.name: sma_180
indicators.purpose: 15-minute SMA as intraday trend filter. NOT scaled 12x from original 200-bar 1-min SMA (which would give 2400 bars = 200 minutes — far too slow for 30-120s trades). 180 bars = 15 minutes chosen because it is the shortest SMA that reliably captures NIFTY intraday trend direction driven by institutional flows: faster SMAs whipsaw on 5s noise, while the 15-min window is long enough to represent a meaningful TWAP/VWAP execution window.

indicators.name: rsi_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute RSI to detect micro-exhaustion. Original used RSI(2) at 1-min (2-bar ultra-sensitivity). At 5s bars, RSI(2) = 10 seconds — pure microstructure noise. RSI(12) = 60 seconds is the minimum lookback at 5s frequency where RSI produces meaningful exhaustion signals without being dominated by single-tick spikes. This directly mirrors the Connors RSI-2 philosophy (ultra-short lookback to catch fleeting exhaustion) but calibrated to 5s bar noise characteristics.

conditions: close > sma_180 (NIFTY is in uptrend by 15-min SMA)
buy_ce.confirmation: RSI dip below threshold while price holds above 15-min SMA — trend intact, exhaustion temporary

conditions: close < sma_180 (NIFTY is in downtrend by 15-min SMA)
buy_pe.confirmation: RSI spike above threshold while price holds below 15-min SMA — downtrend intact, bounce temporary

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points = ~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. If the pullback extends 8 spot points while price is still above the 15-min SMA, the micro-trend assumption is broken — institutional flow has genuinely paused rather than just pulsed. A 4-point option stop gives the position enough room for normal micro-fluctuations (NIFTY 30s typical range: 2-5 pts) without allowing a full trend reversal to damage the position.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points = ~14 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. NIFTY micro-trend resumptions after RSI(12) exhaustion typically cover 12-20 spot points within 60-120 seconds. Targeting 14 spot pts captures the lower half of the expected continuation, achieving 1:1.75 risk-reward while exiting before the move exhausts and reverses.

filters.vix_filter: none (VIX not used; RSI exhaustion signal is self-contained)
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST only (skip pre-open 09:15-09:20 noise and last 5 min)
filters.volume_filter: none (index volume is too noisy at 5s resolution)
filters.spread_filter: none (limit order execution, no spread cost)

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — RSI-2 Connors concept is widely known; alpha depends on 5s execution speed advantage over slower participants

adaptation_notes: Original traded top-50 FNO stocks on 1-min bars, holding 30-60 minutes. Key changes: (1) Universe collapsed to NIFTY index — eliminates stock-specific event risk and stock-picker edge, relies purely on index flow dynamics; (2) Hold time compressed from 30-60 min to 30-120 seconds — required reanchoring all lookbacks; (3) SMA(200) at 1-min → SMA(180) at 5s (15 min) — NOT scaled proportionally; chosen to represent the actual institutional execution timescale on NIFTY rather than mimicking the original numerically; (4) RSI(2) at 1-min → RSI(12) at 5s (1 min) — maintained the ultra-short philosophy but minimum viable lookback at 5s frequency; (5) Exit changed from SMA(5) crossover to fixed stop/target in option premium points — required by 5s option pipeline architecture; (6) ATR stop eliminated (ATR doesn't translate to option premiums).
weaknesses: RSI(12) at 5-second bars may generate false signals during high-frequency noise spikes even with SMA trend filter
SMA(180) lags actual trend turns by up to 15 minutes, causing entries against emerging reversals
NIFTY micro-trends can stall for extended periods without reversing — time stop at 120s may be too short on choppy days
No volatility regime filter — RSI exhaustion pullbacks in low-VIX trending markets differ fundamentally from high-VIX whipsaw conditions
